texts.li: [their:tribal] The hunters of {FACTION} caught {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} trying to drive off their goats. {PLACE} has nowhere to keep a prisoner, and the elders want {X_objective} held until they decide what to do with {X_objective}. They ask the colony to keep {X_nameDef} in its prison for a while.

[their:medieval] {FACTION} have caught {X_nameDef}, a raider of {ENEMY}. The lord's court at {PLACE} will not sit for some days, and the town has no cell that would hold {X_objective}. They ask the colony to keep {X_nameDef} in its prison until then.

[their:industrial] {FACTION}'s militia arrested {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} after a robbery on the road. The lockup at {PLACE} burned down last month. They ask the colony to hold {X_nameDef} until their marshal can take {X_objective} away for trial.

[their:spacer,!their:empire] {FACTION} are holding {X_nameDef}, a fighter of {ENEMY} caught near {PLACE}. Their transport for prisoners is not due for some days. They ask the colony to keep {X_nameDef} in its prison until it comes.

[their:empire] An officer of {FACTION} writes that {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} was taken in an attack on an Imperial convoy. The prisoner must be held until the magistrate's guard can collect {X_objective}, and the officer asks the colony to hold {X_objective} until then.

[wsdef:Council_WS_Assize] {FACTION} have caught {X_nameDef}, a raider of {ENEMY}, and {WSNAME} at {WSPLACE} has more cases than it can hear. They ask the colony to keep {X_nameDef} in its prison until the court can hear {X_objective}.

terms.li: Two of {FACTION} will bring {X_nameDef} to the colony's prison soon after the colony agrees. Keep {X_objective} there as a prisoner for {DAYS}, and do not recruit or release {X_objective}. Like any prisoner, {X_nameDef} may try to break out. After that, {FACTION} will come back for {X_nameDef} and pay {ITEM}. If {X_nameDef} escapes, dies, is let go or joins the colony, {FACTION} will think less of the colony.

accepted.li: {FACTION} will bring {X_nameDef} to the colony's prison soon. Keep a bed in the prison free for {X_objective}.

ready.li: {X_nameDef} is the colony's prisoner now. Keep {X_objective} in the prison for {DAYS}, until {FACTION} come back for {X_objective}.

done.li: [held] {FACTION} came back for {X_nameDef} and paid {ITEM} for keeping {X_objective}. The colony kept its word.

fail.li: [escaped] {X_nameDef} got away from the colony. {FACTION} trusted the colony to hold {X_objective}, and they are angry that it didn't.
[died] {X_nameDef} died while the colony was holding {X_objective}. {FACTION} wanted {X_objective} alive for their own judgement, and they blame the colony.
[kept] The colony took {X_nameDef} in instead of handing {X_objective} back. {FACTION} see it as a broken promise.
[released] The colony let {X_nameDef} go. {FACTION} had asked the colony to hold {X_objective}, and they are angry about it.
[harmed] {X_nameDef} was hurt on the way to the colony's prison. {FACTION} blame the colony for it.
[noprison] The colony had no free bed in its prison when {FACTION} were ready to bring {X_nameDef}, so they kept {X_objective} themselves.
[ended] {FACTION} will not be bringing {X_nameDef} to the colony after all.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} are no longer on terms with the colony, and the arrangement about {X_nameDef} is off.

texts.li: [their:tribal] Two hunters of {FACTION}, {X_nameDef} and {DEAD}, both say they killed the same elk, and both want its hide. The elders of {PLACE} could not settle it, and the two have agreed to let the colony decide.

[their:medieval] {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} of {PLACE} are arguing over a strip of land between their fields. Each says the other moved the boundary stone. {FACTION}'s reeve has given up on them, and they have agreed to let the colony judge it.

[their:industrial] {X_nameDef} sold {DEAD} a tractor part last year and says it was never paid for. {DEAD} says the part was broken when it came. Nobody at {PLACE} wants to take sides, so {FACTION} have asked the colony to judge it.
[their:spacer,!their:empire] {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} of {FACTION} both claim a salvaged power cell. Their crew's contract says nothing about it. They have agreed to accept the colony's judgement.

[their:empire] {X_nameDef} and {DEAD}, two retainers of {FACTION}, are arguing about which of them should sit higher at their lord's table. The steward at {PLACE} will not decide between them, and asks the colony to judge it.

[wsdef:Council_WS_Assize] {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} of {FACTION} could not get a hearing at {WSNAME} at {WSPLACE}, there are so many waiting. They have agreed to let the colony judge their quarrel instead.

terms.li: {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} will come to the colony's gate soon after the colony agrees. {A_nameDef} will hear them, and the colony gives its judgement: for one of them, for the other, or split between them. {FACTION} will pay {ITEM} for the judgement. The one who loses may leave angry, and a quarrel like this can come to blows. If the colony sends them away without a judgement, {FACTION} will think less of it.

accepted.li: {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} of {FACTION} are on their way to the colony to have their quarrel judged.

done.li: [first,!scuffle] The colony found for {X_nameDef}. {X_nameDef} went home pleased, and {DEAD} went home angry. {FACTION} paid {ITEM} for the judgement.
[first,scuffle] The colony found for {X_nameDef}. {DEAD} did not take it well, and the two came to blows before they left. {FACTION} paid {ITEM} for the judgement.
[second,!scuffle] The colony found for {DEAD}. {DEAD} went home pleased, and {X_nameDef} went home angry. {FACTION} paid {ITEM} for the judgement.
[second,scuffle] The colony found for {DEAD}. {X_nameDef} did not take it well, and the two came to blows before they left. {FACTION} paid {ITEM} for the judgement.
[split] The colony split it between {X_nameDef} and {DEAD}. Neither got everything they wanted, but both accepted it and went home. {FACTION} paid {ITEM} for the judgement.

fail.li: [none,!scuffle] The colony gave no judgement, and {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} went home with their quarrel unsettled. {FACTION} feel the colony wasted their time.
[none,scuffle] The colony gave no judgement, and {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} came to blows before they went home. {FACTION} feel the colony wasted their time.
[harmed] {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} came to the colony to have their quarrel judged, and one of them was hurt or held there. {FACTION} will not forget it.
[ended] {X_nameDef} and {DEAD} will not be coming to the colony after all.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} are no longer on terms with the colony, and will settle their quarrel without it.

texts.li: [their:tribal] {X_nameDef} says the elk fell to {X_possessive} spear, and points to the wound. {DEAD} says {DEAD}'s arrow hit it first and brought it down. {A_nameDef} has heard them both, and the colony must give its judgement.

[their:medieval] {X_nameDef} says the boundary stone stood two paces further west in {X_possessive} father's time. {DEAD} says the stone has not moved in thirty years. {A_nameDef} has heard them both, and the colony must give its judgement.

[their:industrial] {X_nameDef} wants {DEAD} to pay for the part or give it back. {DEAD} says the part was cracked and never worked, and owes nothing for it. {A_nameDef} has heard them both, and the colony must give its judgement.

[their:spacer,!their:empire] {X_nameDef} says {X_pronoun} found the cell and only asked {DEAD} to help carry it. {DEAD} says they found it together and should share what it sells for. {A_nameDef} has heard them both, and the colony must give its judgement.

[their:empire] {X_nameDef} says {X_possessive} family has served the lord the longest. {DEAD} says {DEAD} was given the higher title at the last ceremony. {A_nameDef} has heard them both, and the colony must give its judgement.

li.label: Send them off without a judgement

texts.li: [raiders,their:lowtech] A runner from {PLACE} has brought word that {FACTION}'s messenger, {X_nameDef}, was attacked by raiders on the road and is badly hurt. {X_nameDef} is making for the colony, the nearest safe place, with a {TALE} for {FACTION}.

[beasts,their:lowtech] A runner from {PLACE} has brought word that {FACTION}'s messenger, {X_nameDef}, was attacked by wild animals on the road and is badly hurt. {X_nameDef} is making for the colony, the nearest safe place, with a {TALE} for {FACTION}.

[raiders,their:hightech,!their:empire] {FACTION} sent a radio message from {PLACE}: their messenger, {X_nameDef}, was shot by raiders on the road and is making for the colony, the nearest safe place. {X_nameDef} is carrying a {TALE} that must not be lost.

[beasts,their:hightech,!their:empire] {FACTION} sent a radio message from {PLACE}: their messenger, {X_nameDef}, was attacked by wild animals on the road and is making for the colony, the nearest safe place. {X_nameDef} is carrying a {TALE} that must not be lost.

[their:empire] An officer of {FACTION} sends word that the courier {X_nameDef} was attacked on the road and is making for the colony, wounded, with a {TALE} for the household at {PLACE}. The officer asks the colony to take {X_nameDef} in.

terms.li: {X_nameDef} will reach the colony's gate soon after the colony agrees, and will hand over the {TALE}. Give {X_nameDef} a bed, have a doctor treat {X_objective}, and keep {X_objective} fed until {X_pronoun} is well. Keep the {TALE} safe for {DAYS}, until {FACTION}'s people come for it. They will pay {ITEM}. If {X_nameDef} dies at the colony, or the {TALE} is lost, {FACTION} will hold it against the colony.

accepted.li: {FACTION}'s messenger {X_nameDef} is on the way to the colony, wounded. Have a bed and a doctor ready.

ready.li: {X_nameDef} reached the gate and handed over the {TALE}. Get {X_objective} into a bed and have a doctor treat {X_objective}, and keep the {TALE} safe until {FACTION} come for it.

done.li: [delivered] {FACTION}'s people came for the {TALE} and paid {ITEM} for looking after {X_nameDef} and keeping it safe.

fail.li: [died] {X_nameDef} died at the colony. {FACTION} trusted the colony to look after their messenger, and they blame it.
[lost] The {TALE} {X_nameDef} brought is gone. {FACTION} needed it, and they blame the colony for losing it.
[ended] {X_nameDef} will not be coming to the colony after all.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} are no longer on terms with the colony, and will not send for the {TALE}.

IncidentDef.label: an outlaw on the colony's land

titles.li: An outlaw on the colony's land

texts.li: [their:tribal] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} killed a hunter of {FACTION} and ran. The trackers of {PLACE} followed the trail onto the colony's land and lost it there. They ask the colony to catch {X_nameDef}, alive if it can.

[their:medieval] {FACTION} have put a price on {X_nameDef}, a bandit of {ENEMY} who has been robbing travellers on the roads near {PLACE}. {X_nameDef} was last seen going onto the colony's land, and is hiding there.
[their:industrial] {FACTION} have a bounty out on {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY}, wanted for robbing the store at {PLACE}. Their scouts say {X_nameDef} is hiding somewhere on the colony's land.
[their:spacer,!their:empire] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} escaped from {FACTION}'s holding cells at {PLACE}. Their trackers followed {X_objective} to the colony's land and lost the trail there.
[their:empire] {FACTION} have named {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} an outlaw for an attack on an Imperial convoy. The Empire offers a reward for {X_objective}, and {X_nameDef} is hiding on the colony's land.

[ws:roads] The roads near {PLACE} have been dangerous all season, and {FACTION} have put a price on {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY}, who has been robbing travellers there. {X_nameDef} was last seen going onto the colony's land, and is hiding there.

[wsdef:Council_WS_Warlord] {FACTION} say {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} used {WSNAME}'s raids as cover to rob their people near {PLACE}. They have put a price on {X_objective}, and {X_nameDef} is hiding somewhere on the colony's land.

[wsdef:Council_WS_BanditLordFalls] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} rode with {WSNAME} until the bandit lord fell, and has been robbing travellers near {PLACE} since. {FACTION} have put a price on {X_objective}, and {X_nameDef} is hiding somewhere on the colony's land.

terms.li: [hills] {X_nameDef} is hiding somewhere to the {TALE} of the colony, at the foot of the hills. Find {X_objective} within {DAYS} of the colony agreeing. {X_nameDef} is armed, and will fight or run once found. Capture {X_objective} or kill {X_objective}: {FACTION} will pay {ITEM}. If {X_nameDef} gets away or is never found, {FACTION} will think less of the colony.

[edge] {X_nameDef} is hiding somewhere to the {TALE} of the colony, near the edge of its land. Find {X_objective} within {DAYS} of the colony agreeing. {X_nameDef} is armed, and will fight or run once found. Capture {X_objective} or kill {X_objective}: {FACTION} will pay {ITEM}. If {X_nameDef} gets away or is never found, {FACTION} will think less of the colony.

accepted.li: {X_nameDef} is hiding somewhere to the {TALE} of the colony. Whoever goes looking for {X_objective} should be ready for a fight.

done.li: [captured] The colony captured {X_nameDef} and handed {X_objective} over to {FACTION}, who paid {ITEM}.
[killed] The colony killed {X_nameDef}. {FACTION} paid {ITEM}, the price they had put on {X_objective}.

fail.li: [fled] {X_nameDef} got off the colony's land. {FACTION} had counted on the colony to stop {X_objective}.
[unfound] Nobody of the colony found {X_nameDef}, and {X_pronoun} has moved on. {FACTION} are disappointed.
[kept] The colony took {X_nameDef} in instead of handing {X_objective} over. {FACTION} wanted {X_objective} for their own judgement, and are angry.
[ended] {FACTION} no longer need the colony's help with {X_nameDef}.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} are no longer on terms with the colony, and the price on {X_nameDef} is no longer the colony's business.

titles.li: A keepsake lost on the colony's land

texts.li: [hide] {DEAD} of {FACTION} lost a {TALE} crossing the colony's land. It is painted with the marks of {DEAD}'s family, and {DEAD} has carried it since childhood. {DEAD} knows roughly where it fell and asks the colony to look for it.

[book,!their:empire] {DEAD} of {FACTION} dropped a {TALE} on the way through the colony's land. It holds the names of {DEAD}'s family going back many generations, written by hand. {DEAD} knows roughly where it was lost and asks the colony to find it.

[book,their:empire] {DEAD}, a retainer of {FACTION}, lost a {TALE} on the road across the colony's land. It records the family's years of service to their lord, and {DEAD} would be ashamed to go home without it. {DEAD} knows roughly where it fell.

[photos] {DEAD} of {FACTION} lost a {TALE} crossing the colony's land. The photographs in it are the only ones {DEAD} has of {DEAD}'s family. {DEAD} knows roughly where it was dropped and asks the colony to find it.

terms.li: It lies somewhere in an area that will be marked on the map. To search it, select a colonist and right-click inside the area: they search one spot at a time, about an hour each, until they find it. It lies in the open, and 6 hours of rain or snow on it will ruin it. Find it within {DAYS} of the colony agreeing, and {FACTION}'s people will come for it and pay {ITEM}. If it is ruined or not found in time, {FACTION} will be disappointed in the colony.

accepted.li: {DEAD}'s {TALE} lies somewhere in the area marked on the map. Select a colonist and right-click inside the area to search it.

ready.li: {A_nameDef} found {DEAD}'s {TALE}. Keep it safe until {FACTION} come for it.

done.li: [returned] {FACTION}'s people came for {DEAD}'s {TALE} and paid {ITEM}. {DEAD} sends thanks.

fail.li: [spoiled] Rain soaked {DEAD}'s {TALE} where it lay, and it is ruined. It is still lying in the area, but it is no use to {DEAD} now.
[theyfound] {FACTION} sent someone to search the area, and they found {DEAD}'s {TALE} themselves. They had hoped the colony would find it.
[toolate] Nobody found {DEAD}'s {TALE} in time. {FACTION} are disappointed.
[lost] {DEAD}'s {TALE} was found and then lost again before {FACTION} came for it. They are angry about it.
[ended] {FACTION} no longer need the colony to look for {DEAD}'s {TALE}.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} are no longer on terms with the colony, and {DEAD}'s {TALE} is no longer the colony's business.

texts.li: [here,their:tribal] {FACTION} have seen a fine wild {THING} on the colony's land and want it for {PLACE}. Their own people can't get near it. They ask the colony to tame it and hand it over.
[here,their:medieval] The herd-master of {PLACE} has heard of a fine wild {THING} on the colony's land and would like it for {FACTION}'s herds. {FACTION} ask the colony to tame it and hand it over.
[here,their:hightech,!their:empire] {FACTION} want the wild {THING} that has been seen on the colony's land, for their breeding stock at {PLACE}. They ask the colony to tame it and hand it over.
[here,their:tamers] The ring at {PLACE} wants the wild {THING} on the colony's land, and {FACTION}'s tamers would rather the colony tamed it than chase it themselves.
[here,their:empire] A lord of {FACTION} has heard of a fine wild {THING} on the colony's land and wants it for the menagerie at {PLACE}. The steward asks the colony to tame it and hand it over.
[comes,their:lowtech] {FACTION}'s hunters have been following a fine wild {THING}, and it is heading onto the colony's land. They want it for {PLACE}, and ask the colony to tame it and hand it over.

[comes,their:hightech,!their:empire] A wild {THING} that {FACTION} have been tracking is heading onto the colony's land. They want it for their breeding stock at {PLACE}, and ask the colony to tame it and hand it over.
[comes,their:empire] A wild {THING} that a lord of {FACTION} wants for the menagerie at {PLACE} is heading onto the colony's land. The steward asks the colony to tame it and hand it over.

terms.li: [here] The {THING} they want is on the colony's land now, and the quest points to it. Tame it within {DAYS} of the colony agreeing; {A_nameDef} is the colony's best handler. Once it is tame, {FACTION}'s handler will come for it and pay {ITEM}. If the {THING} is killed, or wanders off before it is tamed, {FACTION} will think less of the colony.

[comes] The {THING} will come onto the colony's land soon after the colony agrees, and the quest will point to it. Tame it within {DAYS} of the colony agreeing; {A_nameDef} is the colony's best handler. Once it is tame, {FACTION}'s handler will come for it and pay {ITEM}. If the {THING} is killed, or wanders off before it is tamed, {FACTION} will think less of the colony.

accepted.li: Tame the {THING} {FACTION} want before it wanders off.

ready.li: The {THING} is tame. {FACTION}'s handler will come for it.

done.li: [handed] {FACTION}'s handler came for the {THING} and paid {ITEM}.
[bonded] {FACTION} heard that the {THING} has bonded with someone of the colony, and will leave it where it is. They won't pay for it, but they are not angry.

fail.li: [killed] The {THING} {FACTION} wanted was killed on the colony's land. {FACTION} are angry about it.
[gone] The {THING} {FACTION} wanted is gone from the colony's land. They are disappointed.
[untamed] Nobody of the colony tamed the {THING} in time, and {FACTION} have given up on it.
[ended] {FACTION} no longer want the {THING}.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} are no longer on terms with the colony, and the {THING} is the colony's own business now.
